instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-17_input.step. Keep the 170 x 110 x 12 mm base outside envelope. Cut a through rectangular window spanning X=35..135 and Y=28..82. Cut four vertical through corner mounting holes of diameter 8 mm at (18,18), (152,18), (18,92), and (152,92). Add and fuse top reinforcing ribs: one front rib spanning X=20..150, Y=22..28, Z=12..24; one rear rib spanning X=20..150, Y=82..88, Z=12..24; and one interrupted center rib split into two segments spanning X=79..91, Y=12..28 and Y=82..98, Z=12..20. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-17_output.step. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH). Use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for the FreeCAD command-line work in this task when working on `freecad_task-17_input.step`.
